business_problem: General Dynamics Mission Systems processed highly variable supplier quotations and contract documents across about 30,000 vendors. Legacy data architecture and internal language models made document parsing unreliable, while manual entry and machine-learning maintenance diverted a small data-science team from higher-value work.
solution_summary: General Dynamics Mission Systems uses Snowflake AI Data Cloud and Cortex AI Functions to automate sales-quotation processing. Quotations are uploaded as PDFs; Snowflake AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT and AI_COMPLETE extract relevant information from unstructured documents, while Streams and Tasks transform the results and write them to Salesforce. The workflow processes points of interest and updates Salesforce within two minutes, reducing manual data entry and improving turnaround for buyers and vendors. GDMS also uses Snowflake to ingest software-licensing and usage data for spend analytics, and the platform reduces the team's effort spent troubleshooting ML dependencies. The source identifies Cortex AI and document functions but does not specify the exact LLM used for each quote or the detailed schema of Salesforce records.

data_flow: Supplier quotation PDFs are uploaded to Snowflake; Cortex AI Functions parse and extract relevant content, Streams and Tasks transform and orchestrate the workflow, and the resulting quotation data is written to Salesforce.
integration_points: Supplier quotations and contract documents in PDF
business_outcome: The quotation workflow runs up to 120 times faster, with extraction and Salesforce updates occurring within two minutes of upload. GDMS expects more than $1.3 million in annual productivity savings and reports less effort maintaining ML dependencies.
